testcase.name: [API-004] Missing Input Validation Patterns
testcase.error:
No input validation constraints (minLength, maxLength, pattern, @Valid) found in API definitions.
Severity: MEDIUM File: N/A Remediation: Add validation constraints to all request parameters: minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum, maximum in OpenAPI spec or @Valid annotations in code. OWASP: API3:2023 - Broken Object Property Level Authorization CWE: CWE-20

testcase.name: [API-005] No Rate Limiting Configuration
testcase.error:
No rate limiting mechanism detected. APIs without rate limiting are vulnerable to abuse and denial of service.
Severity: MEDIUM File: N/A Remediation: Implement rate limiting using Bucket4j (Java), express-rate-limit (Node.js), or API Gateway throttling. Configure per-user and per-IP limits. OWASP: API4:2023 - Unrestricted Resource Consumption CWE: CWE-770

testcase.name: [API-006] Missing API Versioning Strategy
testcase.error:
No API versioning pattern detected (/v1/, /v2/, version headers). Versioning enables safe deprecation of insecure endpoints.
Severity: LOW File: N/A Remediation: Implement URL-based versioning (/api/v1/) or header-based versioning (Accept: application/vnd.api.v1+json). OWASP: API9:2023 - Improper Inventory Management CWE: N/A

testcase.name: [CC-001] Missing OAuth2/JWT Configuration
testcase.failure:
No OAuth2 or JWT authentication configuration found. APIs must authenticate requests.
Severity: HIGH File: N/A Remediation: Configure Spring Security OAuth2 Resource Server or implement JWT validation middleware. OWASP: API2:2023 - Broken Authentication CWE: CWE-306

testcase.name: [CC-002] Missing Authorization Controls
testcase.failure:
No authorization annotations or middleware found. Endpoints may be accessible without proper access control.
Severity: HIGH File: N/A Remediation: Add @PreAuthorize, @Secured, or @RolesAllowed annotations (Java) or auth middleware (Node.js) to all endpoints. OWASP: API1:2023 - Broken Object Level Authorization CWE: CWE-862

testcase.name: [CC-003] Missing Input Validation
testcase.error:
No input validation annotations or middleware detected. User input must be validated before processing.
Severity: MEDIUM File: N/A Remediation: Add @Valid, @Pattern, @Size annotations (Java) or Joi/Zod validation schemas (Node.js) to all request handlers. OWASP: API3:2023 - Broken Object Property Level Authorization CWE: CWE-20

testcase.name: [CC-006] Missing CORS Configuration
testcase.error:
No CORS configuration found. Without explicit CORS policy, browsers may block legitimate requests or allow unauthorized origins.
Severity: MEDIUM File: N/A Remediation: Configure explicit CORS origins (never use '*' in production). Set allowed methods, headers, and credentials policy. OWASP: API8:2023 - Security Misconfiguration CWE: CWE-942

testcase.name: [CC-007] Missing Global Error Handler
testcase.error:
No global exception handler found. Unhandled errors may leak stack traces and internal details to clients.
Severity: MEDIUM File: N/A Remediation: Implement @ControllerAdvice (Java) or global error middleware (Node.js) that returns sanitized error responses. OWASP: API8:2023 - Security Misconfiguration CWE: CWE-209

testcase.name: [CC-008] Missing Security Logging
testcase.error:
No security event logging configuration found. Security events must be logged for audit and incident response.
Severity: LOW File: N/A Remediation: Configure structured logging for authentication events, authorization failures, and input validation errors. OWASP: API9:2023 - Improper Inventory Management CWE: CWE-778
